name: FinancialFilings
description:
FinancialReports gives Claude direct, read-only access to regulatory filings, normalized financial statements, and corporate reference data for listed companies worldwide — sourced from official regulators including the SEC and ESMA.

Connect your free FinancialReports account via OAuth (no API key to copy) and Claude can:
• Search and look up companies by name, ticker, ISIN, country, or industry, and retrieve full profiles (LEI, exchanges, IR links).
• Find and retrieve regulatory filings — list by company, type, or date; pull a filing’s full text as markdown; and keyword-search inside a single filing.
• Read normalized financial statements with explicit currency and fiscal period (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow).
• Look up ISINs and dual-listings, and browse the ISIC industry taxonomy and filing-type catalog.

All tools are strictly read-only — the connector retrieves public-company data and never writes, trades, or transacts. Built on the open Model Context Protocol; data is served from FinancialReports’ own first-party API.

Ideal for equity research, financial analysis, due diligence, and monitoring filings across global markets.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FinancialFilings to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FinancialFilings to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.financialfilings.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FinancialFilings MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FinancialFilings lists 15 MCP tools, including companies_financials_retrieve, companies_list, companies_next_annual_report_retrieve, companies_retrieve, filing_categories_list, filing_types_list, filings_list, filings_markdown_retrieve, filings_markdown_search, filings_retrieve, get_fr_filing_type_taxonomy, and get_fr_industry_classification_isic.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FinancialFilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FinancialFilings in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
FinancialFilings requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
FinancialFilings is developed by FinancialFilings. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
